subject: Re: Frostline production latency & 502 spike — cross-region failover
messages:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@frostlinehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Frostline Ops <ops@frostlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Frostline production latency and 502 surge — immediate help needed

Hi Karthik,

We're seeing a sharp spike in 502s and sustained latency for our production traffic routed to us-west-2 (primarily AZ: us-west-2a) starting ~08:50 PDT. Error rate jumped from ~0.2% to 7% and p50 latency climbed from 120ms to ~1.1s. Throughput is down ~22% compared to yesterday. We're in the middle of peak transaction volume and this is impacting patient-facing flows.

Attached is a short snippet from our logs (frostline_502_snippet.log). We tried scaling on our side but the errors appear to be originating from the Redwood inference endpoint (502s, TokenStream reset).

Can you confirm:
- Is there a regional issue on Redwood's end for us-west-2?
- Can you initiate a cross-region failover (us-east-1) immediately if routing is degraded?
- We need an executive contact for an SLA escalation if this isn't resolved in the next 30 minutes.

This is P1 for us.

Thanks,
Samantha Lowe
VP Engineering, Frostline Health
S: +1-415-555-0187

Attachments: frostline_502_snippet.log (text, 48KB)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@frostlinehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Frostline production latency and 502 surge — immediate help needed

Samantha — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We're treating this as P1. I’ve looped in Laura (SRE lead), Marissa (Customer Success) and Vivek (dedicated account lead).

Immediate plan:
- Laura: please confirm whether this is a regional infrastructure issue vs model runtime/serving kernel (we need differentiator).
- If region-level, start the cross-region failover to us-east-1 as an active drain and steer.
- Marissa/Vivek: prep an exec note for Frostline leadership and pricing SLA escalation guidance (they're asking for a credit if the window >30m).

Samantha: please confirm you authorize a temporary regional failover to us-east-1. We will include all routing and perf implications in the comms.

I will coordinate the exec loop-in after we have SRE's root cause direction.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Director, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Office: +1-650-555-0123

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Frostline production latency and 502 surge — immediate help needed

Karthik / team — quick status from SRE (observability snapshot attached as short playbook):
- Observed: Increased 5xx (predominantly 502) from serving nodes in us-west-2a and us-west-2b; backend kernel eviction times spiking (KV cache pressure) and transient GPU OOMs on a subset of pods.
- Scope: ~32% of Frostline baseline traffic touches affected nodes (we're seeing partial fanout).
- Immediate mitigation: Initiating controlled drain of traffic from us-west-2 to us-east-1 and enabling our prefix/KV cache warmup on us-east-1 replicas. This is expected to take ~6–9 minutes to reach steady state for most requests.
- Expected user impact: short-lived tail-latency increase (~10–20% on p95) during warmup, overall error rate should drop significantly once failover completes.
- Post-action: we will run a targeted post-mortem and provide request-level traces for Frostline.

I need explicit authorization from the customer to enact the cross-region steer; we've prepared the nws playbook (usw2-failover-playbook-v2.pdf).

Attachment: usw2-failover-playbook-v2.pdf (operational runbook, 1.2MB)

Laura Bennett
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@frostlinehealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@frostlinehealth.com>, Frostline Ops <ops@frostlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Frostline production latency and 502 spike — cross-region failover

Laura, Karthik — authorize failover to us-east-1 now. Please proceed with the controlled drain.

Paul (cc): we're authorizing Redwood to failover while they mitigate. Please keep me updated at 5-minute intervals.

We’ll need a formal exec-level incident summary and a proposal for a one-time credit for this window; escalate to your leadership as needed.

Samantha Lowe
VP Engineering, Frostline Health
